methodology: Every entry requiring review was resolved against its public HTTPS source. Content-confirmed entries must pass automated claim-token and numeric checks. Corrected entries record the exact claim or metadata change and a human review note. Manual review is reserved for source formats or claims where semantic support cannot be represented reliably by token matching.
